For me, living a good life means being surrounded by the people I love. My abuela used to say, "La familia es todo" - family is everything. And I believe that's true. My kids, my siblings, my parents... they're all I have now, you know? My ex-husband and I, we're separated, but we're still trying to co-parent, for the kids' sake. (pauses, looking down) It's not always easy, but it's worth it.

Work-wise, I just want to be able to provide for them, give them a better life than I had growing up. My job at the furniture factory is... it's not glamorous, but it's honest work. I like working with my hands, making something with my own two hands. And I'm proud of what I do, even if it's not always easy.

Like cooking traditional dishes for my family, or reading a good book by a Mexican author... (smiles) Like Isabel Allende, she's one of my favorites. Her stories transport me to another world.

(pauses, looking around the room) I guess what I'm saying is, living a good life is about finding balance, you know? Between work and family, between giving and taking care of myself. It's not always easy, but it's worth it. (nods)
